title: Page 9
lines: “非所爱。”
尚善错愕地张着小嘴，“非所爱不举？”
“嗯。”好险当初他有那么做，不然他就真要孤家寡人一辈子了。
“我是何时成了你心中所爱的？”他都忘了之前她是如何一日按三顿的揍他吗？他被虐上瘾了？
“我也不知道。”满心无解的斐然也说不出个时间点，“大概是不知不觉中吧……”该不会是那个非所爱中的“爱”，范围广阔到也包括了疼爱、怜爱与心爱吧？
她渐渐有些明白，他家大哥斐思年想排队揍他的心情了……
“这些一点都不重要。”慾求不满的斐然还想再将她拉回来止饥一下，“来，咱们再回头讨论一下我的冲动。”
“吃你的年糕吧。”她赏他两记白眼，把都快化身成狼的他推到一边去。
“说到吃这一点……”他怀念地舔舔唇角，“待开春后，咱们再回皇爷府打打牙祭？”也不知是极山道观的地理环境有问题，还是近墨者黑的缘故，近来素菜吃多了，他也变得和她一样时时都想着吃肉。
她不以为然地挑高一双黛眉。
不是打牙祭，而是去打劫皇爷府的厨房吧？都已经被斐思年给踢出来一次了，他还敢再带着她回去挑战那只笑面虎？
窗外的大雪不知是何时停了，斐然起身去推开窗扇让室内通通风，外头携着寒意的风儿吹进了房里时，也携来了斐然的低语。
“善善。”
他沉吟了一会儿，“找个时间……跟清罡真人说说我俩的事吧？”
“好啊。”她平平板板地应着，没有丝毫激动的情绪。
“好……”他旋即转过身，满脸错愕地问，“等等，你说什么？”
她再重复一遍，“好啊。”
“你就这么轻易的答应我？”他还以为她要考虑一段时间，或是会给他出些什么难题，没想到她居然这么爽快？
尚善神情自若地问：“我得再矜持一下？”
“你究竟知不知道我在说什么？”他可不仅仅是在向她剖白他的心迹，他还想正大光明地将他俩的关系更进一步，他这是在向她提亲，她懂吗？
“知道。”她不傻不呆，更不是没感觉的木头人，天底下哪有魂主魂役的关系是像他们这般的？
他忐忐不已地按着狂跳的心口，“那……”
“我赖定你了。”尚善两手拉下他的面颊，在他的唇上咬了一记，“你欠我的，你这辈子永远都还不完，在你寿终之前，你休想再丢下我一回。”
斐然一手抚着被咬痛的唇，傻愣愣地沉醉在人生中一直求而不得，如今却已握在手心中的感情。
只是在男人堆中住惯了的尚善，远远比他更加不懂什么浪漫旖旎的情调，都不留时间再让他继续感动一会儿，她就又将他给拉回残酷的现实里。
“对了，既然你要告诉我师父，我建议你还是事先准备一下比较好。”嗯，依她看，她还是先去向师公要一些专门用来治疗的黄符好了。
“准备什么？”怎么他的背后忽然有股凉意？
“伤残的可能性。”虽说清罡是不能伤他性命，但断手断脚还是可以的。
斐然偷偷摸摸地蹲在大殿玉阶下方的暗处，屏气凝神地等待了许久，在等到了蹑着步伐朝他跑来的尚善后，他小心地将她拖进阴影里，伸首看了看四下，压低了音量附在她的耳边问。
“如何？”
尚善抹去额上因奔跑而沁出的汗水。
“师公已经把我师父带去十二师祖那边打牌了。”拿出两包知书偷渡上山的牛肉干贿赂清远真人这个内应后，她家那个最是尊师重道，从不敢违抗师命的师父大人总算被引开了。
斐然握紧她的手朝她重重一点头，“咱们走。”
“等等，守在山门那边的三十九师祖怎么办？”下山的路可不只她师父这一关呢。
“昨儿个我就飞鸽传书叫达礼给他扛两坛子酒过去了，他说到时他会睁只眼闭只眼的。”是人就会有弱点，哪怕是已经得道成仙的人也一样，对付这些老道士，他只要针对他们的喜好下手就行了。
“那好，咱们走吧。”尚善敛去眼底兴奋的眸光，牵着他的手快步跑向通往山门之处的小路，在未融的雪地上，留下了两串一大一小的脚印。
都怪观里的那些老道士，他们仗着自个儿有着一身法力，自年前起就一直不肯从牌桌上下来。
最让斐然他们头痛的是，老道士他们不但打起牌来毫无节制，吃起零嘴也从不控制，在他们吃光了年前斐然为他们所炒制的零嘴后，不习惯嘴巴空空的他们，便打起了存粮的主意，开始要尚善天天变花样做给他们吃。
拜他们所赐，道观中的存粮几乎被他们给吃个精光，害得没有东西可吃的尚善和斐然已经接连吃了七天的萝卜，若是再这么吃下去，只怕他们的身上也快要长出萝卜来了。
长时间身处在挨饿困境中，斐然他们不得不为了肚皮起身反抗，所以这才会计画了一连串下山逃跑事宜，而今日，就是他们起义赴诸行动的时候。
将马车停在山门外的达礼，此刻正站在马车旁，目光灼灼地直盯着山门后那条长长的石阶。不过多久，两抹人影飞快地冲下山来，一把人接到，他随即爬上马车座扬起手上的长鞭。
偷溜下山的行动，在里应外合下，进行得顺利无比，一抵达镇上客栈，斐然便拉着尚善走至由知书事先预订好的位置，当各式热腾腾的荤菜全数端上桌后，他们便开始……不顾形象埋头猛吃。
或许真是被饿得狠了，他俩用起膳来，表情也格外地凶狠，知书在吃相野蛮的他们已将大半的饭菜扫进腹里时，忍不住出声打断他们的进食。
“三爷还有小姐……”
“唔？”嘴中塞满东西的两人没有停止手边的动作，只是动作一致地抬起头。
知书抬手指向那些全都躲在客栈一角，面上写满惧色的客人。
“你们吓到其他的客人了。”万一以后老板不让他们进来打牙祭怎么办？这小镇上也才这么一间客栈啊，难不成要他来这开一间专供他们用饭吗？
肚子才填了个半饱的斐然闻言，眼中不禁泛着凄苦的泪光。
“你不懂我们的苦……”天天萝卜又萝卜，最后一根萝卜已在昨晚被他俩给分食完毕，他们要是再不下山来，明儿个起，就得换白菜了。
“……”他只知道皇爷府的脸全都给他们丢光了。
清光桌上所有佳肴的两人，这才一吃饱，马上就被吓坏的老板给请出了大门去，他俩挺着好久没有那么圆润的肚子，已经过惯惨无人道日子的他们，总算有种苦尽甘来、又再次重新活回人间的真实感。
天色一点一点地暗下来，大街上往来的行人也不断地增加，尚善看着镇上男女老幼手中所提着的灯笼，这才恍然忆起今日是元宵节。
斐然拿出事前就让知书买好的灯笼，递给看得一脸羡慕的她。
她欣喜地接过荷花造型的灯笼，“你连这都准备好了？”
“应该的。”他揉揉她的发，牵着她的手同镇上的男女一样游街去。
刻意放慢了脚下的步子，仔细品味着每一盏灯火的流丽，他们一路上边吃喝边赏灯，在走到镇上小庙的前头时，远远地看见了戏班子所搭设的篷架，与一大片挤在戏台下看戏的人群。
content_en:
"Not the one you love."
Shang Shan opened his mouth in astonishment, "Don't do it if you don't love it?"
"Yeah." It's a good thing he did that in the first place, otherwise he would have been alone for the rest of his life.
“我是何时成了你心中所爱的？”他都忘了之前她是如何一日按三顿的揍他吗？ Is he addicted to abuse?
"I don't know either." Fei Ran, who was full of confusion, couldn't tell the time, "Probably unconsciously..." Could it be the "love" that is not loved, and its scope is so broad that it also includes love, affection and belovedness, right?
She gradually understood how his eldest brother Feisinian wanted to line up and beat him up...
"These are not important at all." The dissatisfied Fei Ran wanted to pull her back to quell her hunger, "Come, let's discuss my impulses later."
"Eat your rice cake." She gave him a double look and pushed him aside who was about to turn into a wolf.
"Speaking of eating..." He licked his lips nostalgically, "After spring, let's go back to the Emperor's Mansion for the tooth ceremony?" I don't know if it's because of the geographical environment of Jishan Taoist Temple, or because people close to black are dark. Recently, he has eaten too many vegetarian dishes, and like her, he has become obsessed with eating meat.
She raised her eyebrows disapprovingly.
It's not a tooth-beating ceremony, but to rob the kitchen of the Emperor's Mansion, right? She had already been kicked out by Feisinian once. How dare he take her back to challenge the smiling tiger again?
I don't know when the heavy snow outside the window stopped. Fei Ran got up and opened the window sash to ventilate the room. When the chilly wind from outside blew into the room, it also brought Fei Ran's whisper.
"Good, good, good."
"Huh?"
He pondered for a while, "Find some time... talk to Master Qinggang about us?"
"Okay." She responded flatly, without any emotion.
"Okay..." He turned around immediately and asked with a look of astonishment on his face, "Wait, what did you say?"
She repeated, "Okay."
"You agreed to me so easily?" He thought she would have to think about it for a while, or would ask him some difficult questions, but he didn't expect her to be so forthcoming?
Shang Shan asked calmly: "Should I be more reserved?"
"Do you know what I'm talking about?" He was not only confessing his feelings to her, he also wanted to take their relationship to a new level openly. He was proposing marriage to her, did she understand?
"I know." She is neither stupid nor stupid, and she is not an insensate wooden person. How can there be any soul master and soul servant in the world who have a relationship like theirs?
He anxiously pressed his pounding heart, "Then..."
"I trust you." Shang Shan pulled his cheek down with both hands and bit his lip, "You will never be able to repay what you owe me in this life. Before you die, you will never leave me again."
Fei Ran stroked his sore bitten lip with one hand, stupidly indulging in the feelings that he had been unable to ask for in his life, but now he held them in his hands.
It's just that Shang Shan, who is used to living among men, is far less understanding of romantic and charming emotions than he is. She doesn't leave any time to let him continue to be moved for a while, and she pulls him back to the cruel reality.
"By the way, since you are going to tell my master, I suggest you prepare it in advance." Well, in her opinion, she should first ask her master for some yellow talismans specially used for healing.
"What are you preparing for?" Why did there suddenly feel a chill behind him?
"Possibility of disability." Although Qing Gang could not injure his life, it was still possible to cut off his hands and feet.
"..."
Chapter 8(2)
Fei Ran sneakily crouched in the darkness under the jade steps of the main hall and waited with bated breath for a long time. After waiting for Shang Shan to run toward him with tiptoeing steps, he carefully dragged her into the shadow, stretched his head and looked around, lowered his voice and asked in her ear.
"How?"
Shang Shan wiped the sweat from running on his forehead.
"The master has taken my master to the twelfth master to play cards." After taking out two packages of beef jerky that Zhishu had smuggled up the mountain to bribe the insider Qingyuan Zhenren, the master in her family who respected his master the most and never dared to disobey his master was finally lured away.
Feiran squeezed her hand and nodded heavily to her, "Let's go."
"Wait a minute, what about the thirty-ninth master guarding the mountain gate?" Her master is not the only one who has to go down the mountain.
"Yesterday, I sent a message to Da Li to carry two jars of wine for him. He said that he would turn a blind eye." People have weaknesses, even those who have attained Taoism and become immortals. To deal with these old Taoist priests, he only needs to target their preferences.
"Okay, let's go." Shang Shan put away the excitement in his eyes, took his hand and ran quickly to the path leading to the mountain gate, leaving two sets of footprints, one large and one small, on the unmelted snow.
It's all to blame on the old Taoist priests in the temple. They have been refusing to get off the card table since years ago, relying on their magical power.
What troubled Feiran and the others the most was that the old Taoist priests not only played cards without restraint, but also never controlled their snacks. After they ate all the snacks that Feiran cooked for them years ago, they were not used to having empty mouths, so they decided to save food and began to ask Shang Shan to cook for them every day.
Thanks to them, they almost ate up all the food stored in the Taoist temple. As a result, Shang Shan and Fei Ran, who had nothing to eat, had been eating radishes for seven days in a row. If they continued to eat like this, they would soon grow radishes on their bodies.
Having been in starvation for a long time, Feiran and the others had to stand up and resist for the sake of their belly, so they planned a series of escapes down the mountain. Today is the time for them to rise up and take action.
Dali, who had parked the carriage outside the mountain gate, was standing beside the carriage at the moment, staring straight at the long stone steps behind the mountain gate. Not long after, two figures rushed down the mountain quickly, and when they were caught, they climbed onto the carriage seat and raised the whip in their hands.
"Drive!"
The operation of sneaking down the mountain went very smoothly, both internally and externally. As soon as they arrived at the inn in the town, Feiran pulled Shangshan to the place reserved by Zhishu. When all kinds of hot meat dishes were brought to the table, they began to eat... regardless of their appearance.
Perhaps they were really starving, as they started to eat with extremely fierce expressions. Zhishu couldn't help but interrupt their eating when they had swallowed most of the food into their stomachs.
"Third Master and Miss..."
"Huh?" The two people with their mouths full of things did not stop what they were doing, but just raised their heads in unison.
Zhishu raised his hand and pointed at the guests who were all hiding in a corner of the inn, with fear written on their faces.
"You scared the other customers." What if the boss doesn't let them come in for toothpaste in the future? There is only such an inn in this small town. Is it possible that he should come here to open one just for them to eat?
Fei Ran, whose stomach was only half full, couldn't help but burst into tears when he heard this.
"You don't understand our suffering..." Carrots were eaten every day, and the last radish was eaten by the two of them last night. If they don't come down the mountain, they will have to change it to cabbage tomorrow.
"..." All he knew was that the Emperor's Mansion had been completely humiliated by them.
The two people who had cleared away all the delicacies on the table were immediately invited out of the door by the frightened boss as soon as they were full. They had stomachs that had not been so round for a long time. They had been used to a miserable and inhumane life, and they finally had a sense of reality that after all their hardships, they had finally returned to the human world.
The sky was getting darker little by little, and the number of pedestrians on the street was also increasing. Shang Shan looked at the lanterns held in the hands of men, women, and children in the town, and then suddenly remembered that today was the Lantern Festival.
Feiran took out the lantern that Zhishu had bought in advance and handed it to her who looked at it with envy.
She happily took the lotus-shaped lantern, "Are you even ready for this?"
"It should be." He ruffled her hair, took her hand and walked through the streets like the men and women in the town.
Deliberately slowing down their steps and carefully savoring the beauty of every light, they ate, drank and admired the lights along the way. When they reached the front of the small temple in the town, they saw from a distance the tent set up by the theater troupe and a large crowd of people crowded under the stage to watch the show.
